opennyai_summary.decision:
4. It is submitted that in view of aforesaid fact, cognizance for the offence punishable under Section 420 of the IPC not appears made out.
It is submitted that present complaint case was lodged only out of ulterior and oblique motive with malicious approach and, therefore, the impugned cognizance order dated 30.08.2022 is fit to be set aside/quashed in view of legal report of Hon'ble Supreme Court as available through State of Haryana vs. Bhajan Lal [1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335].
6.
In view of aforesaid submission, let further proceeding qua petitioner in connection with Complaint Case No. 5319(C) of 2022 pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate - 1st Class,
Patna, shall remain stayed till further Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.2209 of 2024(3)
dt.10-07-2025 order.
7.
Let notice be issued to opposite party no. 2 by both modes, i.e. ordinary process as well as registered cover with A/D, for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks from today.
8. Re-notify this matter on 15.10.2025, position be retained.
